source.feed: Chennai unified GTFS (Ithu Ungal Soththu / ungalsoththu/ChennaiGTFS)
source.geometry: Stop sequences from GTFS; road geometry snapped once at preprocessing with the Mapbox Directions API (the feed has no MTC shapes)

selection.rule: Busiest directed stop-to-stop segment in the feed, then the 7 lines (route short-name families, dominant stop pattern in each direction) with the most scheduled trips through it; lines whose two directions differ by more than 20% in trips are skipped
